title: ABCDEF
description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

As an Informatica PowerCenter Developer - Senior Associate, you will play a pivotal role in transforming data into actionable insights within our Data and Analytics Engineering team. You will be at the forefront of data engineering, leveraging your skills to design, develop, and implement data solutions that drive business success. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and developing a deeper understanding of the business context. You will guide and mentor others, navigating complex situations to deliver quality work and grow your personal brand.

In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will collaborate within our Data Modernisation practice, contributing to innovative solutions that enhance data capabilities. You will have the opportunity to work with a diverse team, utilizing your technical strengths to analyze complex concepts and interpret data to inform insights and recommendations. This position offers a dynamic environment where you can develop your skills and expand your professional network, all while contributing to impactful client projects.

Responsibilities
• Developing and maintaining data pipelines using Informatica PowerCenter to support data integration and transformation processes
• Implementing database optimization techniques to enhance performance and efficiency in data management systems
• Utilizing Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Azure Data Factory for scalable data architecture development and deployment
• Designing and managing data warehouses and data lakes to facilitate efficient data storage and retrieval
• Conducting data validation and quality checks to confirm data accuracy and reliability
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to address data challenges and improve data strategy
• Applying analytical thinking to solve complex data engineering problems and improve data infrastructure
• Leveraging Apache Airflow for orchestrating workflows and managing Directed Acrylic Graphs (DAGs)
• Performing dimensional modeling and database administration to support data architecture development
• Engaging in continuous learning and intellectual curiosity to stay updated with emerging data engineering platforms and technologies

What You Must Have
• At least a Bachelor's degree
• At least 4 years of experience
• Oral and written proficiency in English required
• 5+ years of hands-on experience in ETL/ELT development and data integration.
• Strong hands-on experience with Informatica IICS/IDMC, including Cloud Application Integration (CAI) and Cloud Data Integration (CDI), and Informatica PowerCenter.
• Experience supporting migration of ETL workloads from PowerCenter to IICS/IDMC cloud-native platforms.
• Strong hands-on experience with Cloud Data Warehouse like Snowflake /Databricks, including data modeling, optimization, and query tuning.
• Working knowledge of Databricks and Apache Spark for data processing and transformation.
• Experience with API integration and middleware solutions using Informatica CAI.
• Proficient in Python programming to support automation, data processing, and advanced data transformations.
• Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines integrating Snowflake with diverse sources via IICS.
• Design, develop, and unit test complex mappings, workflows, and tasks using IICS, IDMC, and PowerCenter.
• Collaborate with data architects and business analysts to translate business requirements into technical specifications and design.
• Knowledge and hands – on , Snowflake data objects including tables, views, stages, streams, and tasks with focus on performance and cost optimization.
• Should be aware of Snowflake features such as data sharing, events, and lake-house patterns.
• Should have experience with data security and data access controls.
• Good to have AWS, Azure, or GCP data storage and management technologies such as S3, Blob/ADLS, and Google Cloud Storage.

What Sets You Apart
• Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Management Information Systems, Computer and Information Science, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Mathematical Statistics
• Utilizing Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure Databricks
• Developing data pipelines and data integration solutions
• Implementing data warehouse indexing and troubleshooting
• Excelling in data architecture development and optimization
• Leveraging Apache Hadoop and Apache Airflow for data engineering
• Demonstrating proficiency in Snowflake Data Warehouse and Databricks platforms
